diagnostic_threshold_scope: Reporting only, not physical acceptance or reader qualification. Finite endpoints, segment counts and guarded gaps remain separate.
finite_structure_display_gate: Positive R/P >= 90%, exact declared segment count, boundary bijection <= 25 mm, zero guarded gap false length; same-segmentation diagnostic only.
development_replay: Previously scored 44 mixed, 36 section and 40 sampling conditions are three separate development cohorts. Inputs and parent sampling outputs are reused by hash; all 120 are freshly inferred by supported.
parent_reference: 240 historical same-input/same-policy sampling results are exact frozen references, not new inference. New 32 controls run both readers and both representations: total 608 paired rows, 368 fresh executions, 240 references. Cached reader elapsed time is zero, not a speed benchmark.
new_support_cohort: Eight independently authored families times two voxel scales and two physical axial sampling phases, fixed seed 441103 and new pose. Fixed 19 mm step, 1.45 m length, bounded radial noise; full/half shells, real gap, positive tapered surface, actual local missing angles, rotating sparse arc, helix and plane. All new inputs are point-only, so the two representations are identical-input checks, not independent evidence.
freeze_policy: Freeze sources, unlabelled inputs, parent reference map and isolated truth before new inference. Check all 608 ordered normal/reference records, their provenance and exact cached results before truth access. Retain all failures, no post-score parameter changes.
qualification: Four separate development/analytic cohorts, not independent physical objects, foreground recognition, general topology qualification or G1. Positive abstention remains failed recovery, including tapered positive constructions beyond constant-radius model capacity.
